Download **PenButton.exe**, put it in a folder that will stay put (for example `C:\Tools\PenButton`) and run it. It opens the settings window and creates `PenClick.exe`, `PenDoubleClick.exe` and `PenHold.exe` next to itself. Then bind those three in **Settings > Bluetooth & devices > Pen & Windows Ink > Pen shortcuts**. To update, replace PenButton.exe and run it once.

下载 **PenButton.exe**，放到一个固定的文件夹（例如 `C:\Tools\PenButton`）后运行。它会打开设置界面，并在旁边生成 `PenClick.exe`、`PenDoubleClick.exe`、`PenHold.exe`。再到 **设置 > 蓝牙和其他设备 > 笔和 Windows Ink > 笔快捷方式** 里绑定这三个程序。更新时替换 PenButton.exe 再运行一次即可。

Already using PenButton 2.3 or later? It offers this update by itself when you open it.

已经在用 2.3 或更新的版本？打开 PenButton 时它会自动提示更新。

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/liusong299/surface-pen-button/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for what changed.
